launches._curation_note: Predates HDB's Oct 2024 Standard/Plus/Prime classification framework — used the older Non-Mature/Mature Estates system, preserved as-is. This launch's official Annex A PDF is genuinely unrecoverable (live URL dead, zero Wayback captures at all for that path — worse than Nov 2020, which at least had a dead 403 capture). Reconstructed via the housingmap.sg/bto/ fallback: real per-flat-type unit counts and sqm came from each project's HDB sales brochure's rasterized unit-mix table + floor-plan pages (same method as Nov 2020); real 'From' (minimum) prices per flat type came from PropertyGuru's launch-overview article (web.archive.org capture) and its per-town infographic breakdown, cross-verified against the Keat Hong Verge project-specific review article. All unit totals reconcile exactly: each project's total matches its independently-known figure, and the full launch sums to exactly 7,862 units (matching the press release headline). HOWEVER, every price_max value, plus the 2-Room Flexi Type 2 price_min for every project (only Type 1's floor price was ever separately quoted), is ESTIMATED (not sourced from an official HDB document) — extrapolated from this project's real verified 'From' (minimum) price using the min-to-max spread ratio observed in the nearest verified same-classification comparable launch (Sun Sails for Non-Mature Town, Bishan Ridges/Tampines GreenEmerald blend for Mature Town, both Nov 2020, 3 months later). Do not treat as an official HDB figure. Costa Grove's brochure unit-mix table also lists 200 rental flats (58x 1-Room + 142x 2-Room, not for sale to the public) alongside the 1,070 home-ownership units — correctly excluded from flats[]. Several projects (Bishan Towers, Costa Grove) have a 4-Room and/or 3-Room/5-Room row spanning two floor-plan variants (a smaller standard unit and a larger balcony unit) sharing one combined unit count in the source brochure — the smaller/standard sqm is stored, matching the convention used elsewhere in this dataset for the same situation.
